original_text: Construct a method, displayClientName(), to display all client names of company lawyers where a judgment has been passed on the case. Assume that there will always be at least one such client. The method must: y search the allLaywers[] array for lawyerType is “company” y search the lawyerCases[] array for judgmentGiven is “A” y output the client’s name.
